svg.title: Preview environment creation workflow
svg.desc: Step 1: on your laptop, you run mirrord preview start with a container image from a registry, a mirrord.json file, and an optional env key. Step 2: mirrord.json steals incoming traffic with a header filter, and mirrord replaces {{ key }} in every filter with the env key. The CLI prints the env key and the preview session. Step 3: in the staging cluster, a temporary cars-service preview pod starts with your image and lives until its TTL expires. Requests to cars-service that match the env key filter go to the preview pod.
svg.text: Inputs: a container image in a registry, a mirrord.json file,
Requests without the env key still reach the deployed services.
